2157. Checking Whether a Number Is a Perfect Number Using a Function

90

Hard

Problem Statement
Read an integer and determine whether it is a perfect number, using a function that adds up its divisors.

Description
A perfect number is a number that is equal to the sum of all its divisors excluding the number itself. For example, the divisors of 28 (excluding 28) are 1, 2, 4, 7 and 14, and their sum is 28. Read an integer num from input. Write a function isPerfect that uses a for loop to add up all divisors of num smaller than num, and returns 1 if the sum equals num, otherwise 0. In main(), print "Perfect" or "Not Perfect" based on the returned value.

output_spec: Print "Perfect" if num is a perfect number, otherwise print "Not Perfect".
